newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani journalists march to PM Sharif's office.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani journalists march to PM Sharif's office.

text.p: Pakistani journalists marched to Prime Minister Nawaz Sharif's office on Thursday to protest at the arrest of a journalist who has been held incommunicado for 13 days.

A government lawyer told a court on Tuesday that Humayun Far, the Islamabad bureau chief of the Urdu-language daily Mashriq, was in official custody, but he neither gave reasons for the detention nor the name of the agency holding him.

About 100 members of the Rawalpindi-Islamabad Union of Journalists marched to Sharif's office chanting slogans demanding the release of Far, who is not known to have been presented before a court since he was picked up by plainclothed men near his home on the night of June 28.
The police have refused to register a kidnapping complaint by Far's family.
The journalists' unions have called the arrest an attack on press freedom and demanded that Far be charged and tried in an open court.
